**Data Availability, Runtime, and Reproducibility**

The public source data for this case study are available from GEO accession [GSE154386](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE154386){target="_blank"}. The case-study repository contains the source files, scripts, small CSV/JSON tables, and figures needed for the standard path through the analysis. Large raw, preprocessed, model-object, checkpoint, and selected-model reproduction files are stored in a Zenodo reproduction archive; DOI pending publication.

The runtime setup and Docker commands are described in **Packages and Setup**. In brief, the Docker image supplies the software environment, the case-study repository supplies the standard-path files, and the Zenodo archive supplies the large files needed only for full reproduction.

| Resource | Location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Source single-cell data | GEO accession [GSE154386](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE154386){target="_blank"} | Original public data source from Waickman et al. 2021. |
| Case-study source | [opencasestudies/ocs-bio-temporal](https://github.com/opencasestudies/ocs-bio-temporal){target="_blank"} | Source files, scripts, and small included files used by the standard path. |
| Large reproduction files | Zenodo draft; DOI pending publication | Optional full-reproduction files, including raw/preprocessed objects, selected-model inputs and outputs, model objects, checkpoints, and K-selection summaries. |
| Runtime image | `othomas2/cs5-cogaps-runtime:0.1.0` | Docker image that provides R, Python, CoGAPS, PyCoGAPS, and supporting packages. |

The K-selection sweep is documented as precomputed evidence. You will inspect the sweep summaries to understand why `K = 10` was selected, but rerunning the full sweep is not part of the standard path or the full reproduction path.
